infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses the microphone so you can record a sales presentation for your manager to review, and so you can send voice notes in team chats.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your location to confirm you are at the client's site when you log a field visit, and to record where you punched in or out for attendance.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: $(PRODUCT_NAME) shares your location with your manager only while you are punched in for a shift, so field visits can be verified and your route for the day can be recorded. Location is not collected once you punch out.

plugins.microphonePermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses the microphone so you can record a sales presentation for your manager to review, and so you can send voice notes in team chats.

plugins.cameraPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses the camera so you can take a verification selfie when you punch in or out of your shift, and so you can take and send photos in team chats and job reports.

plugins.photosPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) accesses your photo library so you can attach existing images to team chats, upload design files, and submit payment proof for a closed deal.
